_note: Single source of truth for usage windows, soft caps, and reset anchors. NO reset time is hardcoded in policy prose — agents and dispatch run `usage-status` (which computes the next reset from this file) and never eyeball a dashboard to judge limits. When a plan or window changes, edit ONLY this file. Each window's time is local to its own tz. Null anchors mean 'owner has not set this yet' and usage-status will say so instead of guessing.
limit_determination_order: 1. hard machine signal: a real 429 / usage-limit error recorded by a wrapper into usage-ledger.json (authoritative: seat spent until reset)
2. computed window: usage-status rolls the anchor below forward to the next reset instant
3. owner/manual %: a number the owner notes in usage-ledger.json from the provider UI (fallback only)
LLM estimation of remaining quota is not a source — never guess from token counts.

codex-sol.live_signal: hard 429 / usage-limit on a real Codex call → usage-ledger.json; else Codex plan usage UI % noted by owner
codex-sol.reset_note: weekly window is the review gate; the 5h window is short-term throughput

claude-teamclaude.live_signal: `claude` usage / teamclaude seat status; hard limit error on a real call → usage-ledger.json
claude-teamclaude.reset_note: rolling per seat; teamclaude rotates seats inside the window

grok-heavy.live_signal: hard 429 on a real grok call → usage-ledger.json; else SuperGrok usage UI %
grok-heavy.reset_note: SET weekday/time once known; until then usage-status reports the anchor as unset (it will not invent a time)

cursor-other-400.reset_note: SET billing day-of-month; resets on the Cursor billing month

fireworks-review-e.live_signal: hard 429 / usage-limit on a real call; monthly $ from provider dashboard
fireworks-review-e.reset_note: no reset window; owner sets monthly_cap_usd at wiring; over cap → park
